name: Welcome Email
subject: Welcome to STEMulus, {{student_name}} - Your Onboarding Information
body:
Welcome to STEMulus!

Dear {{parent_name}},

We are delighted to welcome {{student_name}} to the {{course_name}} program. Our mission is to provide personalized, engaging, and world-class 1-on-1 coding mentorship.

Next Steps

  • Your class schedule and live session link will be sent prior to your first class.
  • Please ensure your child has a computer or tablet ready with internet access.
  • You can track progress, view schedules, and access learning reports in the Parent Portal.

If you have questions, reply to this email anytime or connect with us on WhatsApp.

Warm regards,
The STEMulus Academic Team

name: Certificate of Completion
subject: Congratulations {{student_name}}! Certificate of Completion Awarded
body:
Certificate of Completion

Dear {{parent_name}},

We are delighted to announce that {{student_name}} has successfully completed the {{course_name}} curriculum at STEMulus Kids Technologies.

Completion Date: {{completion_date}}

This achievement represents significant dedication, project development, and computational problem-solving. We commend {{student_name}}'s outstanding progress.

Recommended Next Pathway

Continue expanding skills with our advanced curriculum offerings:

  • Junior Robotics & Embedded Systems
  • Python Game Architecture & Algorithms
  • Full-Stack Web Development
  • Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

With best regards,
The STEMulus Academic Team
